# ooRexx Semantic Source Control v0.2.3 validation

Runtime:
  ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196 - Internal Test Version

Semantic source level:
  component=SemanticSourceControl
  lineage=MAIN
  sourceLevel=5

Packaged test suites expected for clean-room certification:
  PASS test_semantic_source_control
  PASS test_cli_intake
  PASS test_v02_regressions

  PASS test_v021_cli_pending
  PASS test_v022_terminal_dogfood

  PASS test_v023_relocation_one_to_one
  PASS test_v023_md5_batch md5Invocations=1
  PASS test_v023_legacy_identity immutableOldLevel=true nextLevel=2 tracked=1
  PASS test_v02_performance identicalBaselineSeconds=4

v0.2.3 Federation level-7 hardening:
  - cross-method external-operation relocation is reconciled globally one-to-one;
  - an accepted identity can map to at most one current call-site;
  - a continuing operation retains its identity before any relocation inference;
  - same SQL operation/data source is compatibility evidence, not identity proof;
  - ambiguous or one-to-many same-table additions remain new tracking proposals.

Federation-shaped relocation regression:
  v1: 2 accepted operations
  v2: both extracted to another method -> tracked=2, pending=0
  v3: those 2 continue plus 5 new same-surface operations -> tracked=2, pending=5

Legacy repository adoption:
  - baseline/scan use a compact persisted identity view rather than full historical
    source-blob re-analysis;
  - derived identity views are cached for the command lifecycle and invalidated by
    tracking-decision changes;
  - old accepted evidence remains immutable even when a newer analyzer sees additional
    whole-release files that the old analyzer never indexed.

Real historical FederationBank level-6 repository probe on the r13196 debug host:
  exact sealed-v0.6 re-baseline: approximately 13.7 seconds
  synthetic next-level adoption of the same source: approximately 14.5 seconds
  historical level-6 snapshot.osc SHA-256 unchanged before/after re-baseline

Hash scaling:
  SHA-256 regression: 1,200 explicit methods, sha256sum process invocations=1
  contextual MD5 regression: 200 SQL candidates, md5sum process invocations=1

Earlier v0.2.2 Terminal Machine hardening remains green:
  - first-class ::attribute revisions and GET/SET/BOTH contracts
  - explicit getter/setter body implementation deltas
  - first-class ::constant revisions
  - receiver-aware attribute/constant consumer evidence

Earlier v0.2/v0.2.1 coverage remains green, including:
  - one-line ::method parsing and inline body hashing
  - ::options / ::requires package contracts
  - block/nested-comment lexical exclusion
  - instance/class/object method-side identity
  - receiver-aware constructor and :super evidence
  - package executable-code dependencies
  - whole-release immutable blobs and byte-exact export
  - SQL semantic tracking and host-language suffix cleanup
  - Rexx CALL versus SQL CALL disambiguation
  - root component plus nested ZIP intake
  - whole-number AT_LEAST evaluation
